name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in complex scenes where other upscalers blur edges or lose depth cues—critical for power-focused tasks like terrain analysis or structural inspection. The trade-off is higher compute cost per frame, but the 0.5%+ quality gain justifies it for high-stakes outputs.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under motion, and InstantX-ComfyUI’s compute spike (0.8s/frame on A100) kills real-time throughput. Swap to RealVisXL’s face model on GPU: 0.3s/frame, 12% face fidelity gain, but only if we accept 8GB VRAM cost per instance—benchmark both on the 1080p terrain dataset to settle it.
